facts.text: Jon expressed gratitude for Gina's support and acknowledged the significance of dance in their relationship.

evidence.quote: Wow! It looks awesome! Thanks for the support, it really means a lot.
Nice, Gina! I'm happy that dance has such a special meaning to both of us.

facts.text: Jon mentioned that he enjoyed taking dance lessons with friends in his youth and cherished those memories.

evidence.quote: I loved taking lessons with my friends when I was younger. Those memories are so precious.

facts.text: Gina acknowledged Jon's hard work and encouraged him to continue pushing forward.

evidence.quote: No prob, Jon! You earned all the kudos for your hard work. Keep it up!
Thanks! Gonna keep pushing and working hard. Won't let anything hold me back!
Way to go, Jon! Keep it up, you're almost there!

facts.text: Gina shared a photo of a trophy from a dance contest, highlighting the hard work, dedication, and joy associated with dance.

evidence.quote: Here's one of my trophies from a dance contest, nice reminder of the hard work, dedication and joy it brings.
